condition: Parsing a non-ISO 'DD-MMM-YY' string like '31-DEC-50' without a format string falls back to native Date parsing, so two-digit years 50 and above become 19xx (1950 instead of 2050) and diff results are wrong.
workaround: Load the customParseFormat plugin and pass the format explicitly, e.g. dayjs('31-DEC-50', 'DD-MMM-YY'). That plugin maps two-digit years up to 68 to 20xx. Or use four-digit years.
